cohort: The study included 110 term neonates, comprising 55 with birth asphyxia and 55 healthy controls.
finding: Serum LDH levels were significantly elevated in neonates with birth asphyxia and showed a strong, progressive correlation with increasing severity of Hypoxic-Ischemic Encephalopathy (HIE).
mod_finding: Caesarean section was significantly more common in the birth asphyxia group.
cross-section timing: Serum LDH levels were measured within 6 hours of birth.
